title: Page 4
content_zh:
「竹儿，别多嘴！」相较于竹儿的怒火，绦岚秋美丽的脸庞依旧淡定，轻斥道。
「小姐！你怎么咽得下这口气？」竹儿气得跺脚。
小姐知书达礼、温柔婉约，多少人上门提亲她都不允，偏爱这个封竞天，被他害得失了清白她不怨，成亲不到一日就成了下堂妻她也不恨，她只要光想到就觉得受不了。
「不忍又能如何？」绦岚秋露出一抹苦笑，快步走进观月阁，杜绝身后非议的眼光及蜚语。
「小姐……」不忍小姐如此委屈，竹儿心疼的说：「咱们可以搬回绦府，用不着在这受气，我相信老爷他……」
「竹儿！」绦岚秋回身，美丽的双眸透着严肃，沉声说：「我被休一事绝对不能告诉爹爹，知道吗？」
她好不容易让封竞天答应让她留下且不把休妻一事告诉他人，她不能让竹儿坏事，让年迈的爹爹承担她的过错，受众人指指点点。
竹儿当然知道她的顾虑，但实在不忍她这般委曲求全。
「小姐，难道你没听见方才那些下人的话？他们什么都不知道，就把你说得那么难听，有人甚至还用鄙视的目光看着你，他们怎么能错的人明明不是你，为何是你承担一切？要是咱们继续留在这，只会更让那些人看不起、受那些人的气，你堂堂绦府的大小姐，怎么可以受这样的气！」
她真不懂小姐为何要忍受，她相信要是老爷得知小姐受的委屈，绝对不会让她留下来，再怎样也会替她讨回公道，偏偏小姐就是死心眼，听不进她的劝。
「竹儿，」绦岚秋叹了口气，知道情同姊妹的贴身丫鬟是心疼她，于是放柔嗓道：「何必在意他人的目光？他们不知事情始末，才会妄自猜测，但再怎么样也只能猜测，谁也不能把不是事实的猜疑强压在我身上，你说是不？」
「当然不是……」小姐太单纯，根本不知那些蜚短流长可以将人逼疯。
绦岚秋轻拍她的手，接着又说：「别担心我，我没那么脆弱，你知道的，不是吗？」
她当然知道，跟在小姐身旁十年，她比谁都清楚她看似柔弱，却十分坚强，否则发生这样的事，她哪还能如此淡然？
明白再怎么劝，小姐也不会听，竹儿放弃了，只能疼惜的看着她强颜欢笑，将原本该摆在新房里的嫁妆、衣裳，一一摆放在陈旧的衣柜里。
夏至，在灼灼艳阳的照射下，苍绿的枝叶显得毫无生气，炎热的气候，除了蝉儿奋力的呜叫声外，连一丁点儿的风声都听不见。
然而在这宁静的午后，绦岚秋却隐隐听见远处传来争吵声，那熟悉的嗓音让她秀眉微拧，放下手上的针线，走出房，循着声响而去。
「你这话是什么意思！」竹儿双手擦腰，瞪着拦住她去路的厨娘。
「没听懂是吗？」厨娘不悦的重复一次，「这儿不欢迎像你这种有着失德主子的丫头，还有，除了三餐外，休想我替你那不知羞耻的主子煮食！」
「那也叫三餐？」竹儿气得大吼，「干硬的馒头、没挑过的青菜配酱瓜，还有清汤白面，这叫‘三餐’？」

若不是小姐要她忍，她怎可能忍这么久？
撇开封竞天不说，光是封府下人的吃食用度就不知比她们主仆好上多少，那些狗眼看人低的家伙，在背后把小姐说得难听，甚至联合起来欺压她们，现下就连她想进膳房替小姐煮碗冰糖莲子都不能，这些人简直欺人太甚！
尉娘冷哼一声，「一个不知羞耻的女人还想吃山珍海味？有酱瓜吃就不错了，小心明儿个我只给你们一条番薯，要吃不吃随你们。」
扔下话，厨娘转身就走，进膳房前甚至大力将门给甩上，摆明了不让她进门。
「你——」
竹儿气得浑身发抖，正想冲上前再理论，却被赶来察看的绦岚秋给阻下。
「竹儿！」
「小姐……」一见到主子，竹儿怒火顿时消了一半，取而代之的是浓浓的不安，「你……什么时候来的？」
绦岚秋神情平情，轻声说：「来一会儿了。」
那岂不是全听见了？
竹儿懊恼得想咬下舌头，担忧的看着她毫无波澜的脸庞。
「我没事。」绦岚秋淡淡一笑，反过来安慰道：「再难听的话我都听过了，你别担心我。」
她们在这儿也住了近三个月，府里下人眼尖，打从绦岚秋住进观月阁后就猜测不断，又见这几个月来，封竞天别说是踏进来了，连提都没提起过她这个新婚妻子，流言因此传得更加难听了。
有人说她在嫁进封府前就和别的野男人苟合，新婚夜没有落红，爷因此大怒，却又顾及与绦家的交情，才没将她赶出府。
也有人说她是怀着身孕嫁进封府，目的就是想让爷当现成的爹，被爷给识破，才会被赶至观月阁。
还有人说她身怀残疾、性情古怪，和外头所言的温婉柔顺差了十万八千里，爷因不甘受骗，才会视她为无物……
各种流言传遍封府上下，若不是封竞天下令不许将这些流言传出府，她想她早已成了众人挞伐的荡妇，这么说来，她还得感谢他，至少他遵守与她的约定，没让绦府丢脸。
见她当真没有半点不悦及难过，竹儿却更加心疼，忍不住哽咽，「小姐……你为何要这般容忍，你没听见那厨娘说的话吗？那些下人根本没把我们当人看，那些东西能吃吗？你怕暑气，每每到了夏日，都要喝上好几碗莲子汤消暑，可他们……」
一想到挡住她去路的厨娘，竹儿是又悲又气，眼泪不禁落得更凶。
绦岚秋见状，心头一酸，却不是为自己不平，「竹儿……委屈你了，让你同我一起忍受那些冷言冷语。」

她自己受苦不打紧，毕竟这是她自找的，但竹儿不同，她不该和她一同受罪，或许她该把她送回绦府才是……
「小姐！」竹儿哪会不知她心里所想，急忙摇头，「你别赶我走，竹儿不苦，竹儿是丫鬟命，什么苦吃不得，竹儿只是心疼，堂堂绦府的千金大小姐，却在这受那些下人的欺凌……」
绦岚秋不语，在她心中，没有谁比谁尊贵，下人是人，千金小姐也是人，只要是人都得吃喝拉撒，在吃食上头，他们能吃，她当然也能吃，只是……
说不在意是矫情，再怎么说她过惯了富裕生活，在吃喝用度上定是较为豪奢，干硬的馒头、咸得需要配上一壶茶水的酱菜以及没有任何配料和味道的白面条……这些确实让她食不下咽，但她可以忍，只是她很不舍和她一起受苦的竹儿。
没有莲子汤喝不打紧、没有甜食糕点吃也无所谓，至少她得让两人有顿正常的餐食，若封府的膳房不让她们涉足那也无妨，观月阁也有个小膳房，只是久未使用，有些陈旧脏乱罢了，麻烦的是食材……
她出嫁时，封竞天特地要求不需要任何嫁妆，因此她带来的首饰少得可怜，就是全部变卖，也只足够她们撑上几个月，那剩下的时日该如何是好？更别提一年后，她根本没打算回绦家……
看来为了生计，她势必得和封竞天见上一面，哪怕他一点也不想见她。
第2章(2)
「爷，夫人求见。」封府的老总管在书房外通传。
闻言，封竞天顿时一顿，浓眉倏拧，若不是及时想起和绦岚秋的约定，他差点就要喊出「这里没有什么夫人」。
content_en:
"Zhu'er, don't talk too much!" Compared to Zhu'er's anger, Guan Lanqiu's beautiful face remained calm as she scolded.
"Miss! How can you swallow this breath?" Zhu'er stomped her feet angrily.
The young lady is well-educated, courteous, gentle and graceful. She refuses to accept marriage proposals from many people. She prefers Feng Jingtian. She doesn't complain about being harmed by him and loses her innocence. She doesn't resent that she became a second cousin less than a day after getting married. She feels unbearable just thinking about it.
"What can I do if I can't bear it?" Guan Lanqiu showed a wry smile and quickly walked into Guanyue Pavilion, avoiding the disapproving eyes and rumors behind him.
"Miss..." Unable to bear the grievance made by the young lady, Zhu'er said distressedly: "We can move back to Suanfu, there is no need to suffer here, I believe the master..."
"Zhu'er!" Guan Lanqiu turned around, with seriousness in her beautiful eyes, and said in a deep voice, "You must not tell dad about my divorce, do you understand?"
She finally got Feng Jingtian to agree to let her stay and not tell others about the divorce. She couldn't let Zhuer do bad things and let her elderly father bear her faults and have everyone criticize her.
Of course Zhu'er knew her concerns, but he really couldn't bear her to compromise like this.
"Miss, didn't you hear what those servants just said? They didn't know anything, so they spoke so harshly of you. Some even looked at you with contempt. How could they be wrong? The person who was wrong was obviously not you, so why did you bear everything? If we continue to stay here, we will only make those people look down upon and be more angry. How can you, the eldest lady of your dignified house, be so angry!"
She really didn't understand why the young lady had to endure it. She believed that if the master knew about the grievances that the young lady had suffered, he would never let her stay and would seek justice for her no matter what. However, the young lady was stubborn and refused to listen to her advice.
"Zhu'er," Quan Lanqiu sighed, knowing that her sister-in-law's personal maid felt sorry for her, so she said in a soft voice: "Why do you care about other people's eyes? They don't know the whole story, so they make rash guesses, but no matter what, they can only guess. No one can force suspicions on me that are not facts, don't you think?"
"Of course not..." The young lady is too naive and has no idea that gossip can drive people crazy.
Qi Lanqiu patted her hand, and then said, "Don't worry about me, I'm not that fragile, you know that, right?"
Of course she knew that, having been with the young lady for ten years, she knew better than anyone else that she looked weak but was very strong. Otherwise, how could she be so calm when such a thing happened?
Knowing that no matter how much he tried to persuade her, the young lady would not listen, Zhu'er gave up and could only look at her with a forced smile as she placed the dowry and clothes that were supposed to be placed in the new house one by one in the old wardrobe.
At the summer solstice, under the scorching sun, the green branches and leaves look lifeless. In the hot climate, except for the strenuous chirping of cicadas, not even the slightest sound of wind can be heard.
However, in this quiet afternoon, Guan Lanqiu faintly heard the sound of quarreling in the distance. The familiar voice made her frown slightly, put down the needle and thread in her hands, walked out of the room, and followed the sound.
"What do you mean by that!" Zhu'er wiped her waist with both hands and glared at the cook who blocked her way.
"You don't understand, do you?" the cook repeated displeasedly, "A girl like you with an unscrupulous master is not welcome here. Also, except for three meals, don't expect me to cook for your shameless master!"
"That's also called three meals?" Zhu'er yelled angrily, "Dry and hard steamed buns, unpicked green vegetables with pickled cucumbers, and white noodles in clear soup. This is called 'three meals'?"
If the young lady hadn't asked her to endure it, how could she have endured it for so long?
Leaving aside Feng Jingtian, the food consumption of the servants of Feng Mansion is much better than that of their masters and servants. Those scornful guys spoke ill of the young lady behind her back, and even joined forces to bully them. Now she can't even go into the dining room to cook a bowl of rock sugar lotus seeds for the young lady. These peopleIt’s so deceiving!
Wei Niang snorted coldly, "A shameless woman still wants to eat delicacies from the mountains and seas? It would be nice to have pickled cucumbers. Be careful, I will only give you one sweet potato tomorrow. It's up to you whether you want to eat it or not."
After saying that, the cook turned around and left. She even slammed the door hard before entering the dining room, making it clear that she was not allowed to enter.
"You——"
Zhu'er was so angry that she was trembling all over. She was about to rush forward to argue, but was stopped by Gui Lanqiu who came to check.
"Zhu'er!"
"Miss..." As soon as she saw her master, Zhu'er's anger disappeared by half, replaced by deep uneasiness, "When... did you come?"
Guan Lanqiu looked calm and said softly: "I've been here for a while."
Didn’t you hear everything?
Zhu'er was so annoyed that she wanted to bite off her tongue and looked at her untroubled face with worry.
"I'm fine." Guan Lanqiu smiled faintly and comforted her in turn: "I've heard all the ugly words, don't worry about me."
They had lived here for nearly three months. The servants in the mansion were very discerning and had been speculating ever since Guan Lanqiu moved into Guanyue Pavilion. In the past few months, Feng Jingtian had not even mentioned her as his new wife, let alone stepped in, so the rumors became even more unpleasant.
Some people said that she had an affair with another wild man before marrying into the Feng Mansion. She did not get married on her wedding night. This made her furious, but he did not kick her out of the house because of his friendship with the Sui family.
Some people also say that she married into the Feng Mansion while pregnant, with the purpose of making me a ready-made father. Only after he found out, was she driven to Guanyue Pavilion.
Some people also say that she is disabled and has a weird temperament, which is far different from the gentle and gentle people said outside. Because I am not willing to be deceived, I regard her as nothing...
Various rumors spread throughout the Feng Mansion. If Feng Jingtian hadn't ordered these rumors to be spread out of the house, she thought she would have become a slut criticized by everyone. In this way, she had to thank him. At least he kept his agreement with her and did not embarrass the Sui Mansion.
Seeing that she was not unhappy or sad at all, Zhu'er felt even more distressed and couldn't help but choke up, "Miss... why are you so tolerant? Didn't you hear what the cook said? Those servants didn't treat us as human beings at all. Are those things edible? You are afraid of the heat. Every summer, you have to drink several bowls of lotus seed soup to cool down, but they..."
Thinking of the cook blocking her way, Zhu'er felt sad and angry, and her tears couldn't help falling even more fiercely.
When Guan Lanqiu saw this, she felt sad, but it was not because she was unfair, "Zhu'er... I have wronged you, asking you to endure those cold words with me."
It doesn't matter if she suffers by herself, after all, she asked for it, but Zhu'er is different, she shouldn't suffer with her, maybe she should send her back to Suanfu...
"Miss!" Zhu'er didn't know what she was thinking, and hurriedly shook his head, "Don't drive me away. Zhu'er is not miserable. Zhu'er is a maid. She can't bear any hardship. Zhu'er just feels sorry for me. The rich lady of the Sui Mansion is being bullied by those servants here..."
Guan Lanqiu was silent. In her heart, no one was more noble than anyone else. The servants were human beings, and the rich lady was also a human being. As long as they were human beings, they had to eat, drink, and have sex. When it came to food, if they could eat it, of course she could eat it too, but...
To say she doesn't care is to be pretentious. After all, she is used to living a wealthy life, and her food and drink expenses must be relatively luxurious. Dry steamed buns, pickles so salty that they need to be paired with a pot of tea, and white noodles without any ingredients or taste... These really make her unable to eat, but she can bear it, but she is very reluctant to let go of Zhu'er who suffers with her.
It didn't matter if she didn't have lotus seed soup, or if she didn't have sweets and cakes to eat. At least she had to let the two of them have a normal meal. It would be okay if they were not allowed to set foot in the dining room of Feng Mansion. Guanyue Pavilion also had a small dining room, but it had not been used for a long time and was a bit old and dirty. The trouble was the ingredients...
When she got married, Feng Jingtian specifically asked not to need any dowry, so she broughtTheir jewelry was so meager that even if they were sold off, it would only be enough for them to last for a few months. So what should they do with the remaining time? Not to mention that a year later, she had no intention of returning to Sui's house...
It seemed that in order to make a living, she had to meet Feng Jingtian, even if he didn't want to see her at all.
Chapter 2(2)
"Sir, madam, please see me." The old manager of Feng Mansion announced outside the study.
Hearing this, Feng Jingtian paused and his thick eyebrows furrowed. If he hadn't remembered the agreement with Qian Lanqiu in time, he would have almost shouted, "There is no wife here."
